title: A QUIRKY, ENTERTAINING WAY TO SEE SEVILLE
text: The tour far exceeded our expectations. Roberto, our guide was brilliant, so knowledgeable and fun and clearly passionate about Seville and it's history. We learned a lot and smiled right through the tour. I would recommend to anyone.
author: SILLYPANTSFLOWERPOT

title: Juan
text: Great driver Juan and tour.  Good way to get some history and see sights
author: Michael M

title: A zip around Sevilla with Juan
text: This tour is a great way to see the highlights of Seville outside of the old city. Juan was an amazing knowledgeable and friendly guide who really loves his city and loves sharing his city with you!
author: Margie_M

title: Definitely recommend!
text: Excellent trip made even better thanks to our driver Alejandro who was so knowledgeable and interesting.
author: suzannehodgson

title: Fun and informative overview of beautiful Seville
text:
First of all, communication with the tour operator was excellent. Responses were lightning fast, and the detailed instructions were very clear, which made everything easy from the start.

Our driver and guide, Juan, was exceptional. His cheerful and friendly manner was very much appreciated. We chose the 2-hour tour, and the electric tuk tuk was very pleasant and quiet. There was a small, easy-to-hear speaker that he used while driving, which worked very well.

author: PaulD965

title: Highlights of Seville
text: Our guide was excellent - well informed, friendly, and very considerate. We saw bits of Seville we would have not seen on our own. Alex even took us back to the taxi stand so we could continue our day. He spoke very good English and was a pleasure to tour with.
author: Funexplorer2

title: Lovely hours outing.
text: We were lucky and had Alejandro as our guide. He was very clear to understand and we enjoyed listening to the history of Seville.  Est tuk tuk ever, so comfortable.
author: claire_B

title: Great tour.
text: Karen was very knowledgeable and engaging.  She shared great information with us.  We enjoyed the tour and it gave us a great perspective of the area.
author: Sandra_H

title: Karen is the BEST!
text: We were able to easily book/reserve a tuk-tuk one day in advance through Booking.com. Meeting location is a little weird as it is in the basement of a parkade where the washrooms were very sketchy. However, our Tuk-Tuk driver, Karen, was outstanding. She was friendly, FULL of information, and gave us many great suggestions on sights to see and what to do in Sevilla. Thank you Karen, we really enjoyed our short time with you!,
author: Clarke C

title: Great experience
text: Four of us took this trip as part of a wider tour around beautiful Spain. We wanted to start with a quick whistle stop tour of Seville to help us decide our priorities in planning our day. It was a great introduction to the city with a very knowledgeable and super friendly guide Gorgie.  The tuk tuk was comfortable and provided welcome shade from the pounding sun. Stopping off at the Spanish square was our highlight. Great recommendation for lunch from Gorgie too. We would definitely recommend the tour.
author: Lyn_G
